title: Market Stitchboard: model compatibility dossier and annotated buyers' journey
creator: Arjun Menon
description: Synthesize a compact, exportable ‘stitchboard’ that ties together model compatibility signals (API contract surface, quantization/quant fallback risk, latency buckets per region) with annotated customer journey vignettes for three buyer archetypes (PLG startup, mid-market product team, regulated enterprise). The stitchboard should make it straightforward for GTM and sales to answer: which model variants do we recommend per buyer stage and what fallback/rollout playbook to present during procurement conversations.
acceptance_criteria: 1) One-page stitchboard visual + 6–8 slide annotated dossier capturing model compatibility constraints across latency, token-cost, quantization, and privacy. 2) Three buyer journey narratives with explicit model-recommendation decision trees. 3) Example collateral (one-pager and playbook) approved by Sales and Solutions Engineering. 4) Data sources and signal extraction notebook referenced in links.
risks: Signal freshness: upstream model availability data lags by 7–10 days
Misalignment between recommended fallback economics and actual customer SLAs
Overly prescriptive recommendations that require engineering changes to API compatibility
